designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1935 as an easement refuge under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act, when perpetual easements were bought around Lake Alice.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Lake Alice National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

FWS ServCat: Devils Lake WMD EA and predator plan, incl. Lake Alice compatibility determination (easements bought 1935-36; easement refuge notice in Federal Register Dec. 21, 1948)

review.note: Parser used the Arrowwood WMD sentence (1961). Lake Alice began with 1935-36 easements; a Federal Register notice of Dec. 21, 1948, formally listed it as an easement refuge.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: National Wildlife Refuge Pingree, ND Arrowwood Wetland Management District Arrowwood Wetland Management District was established in 1961 as a breeding ground for migratory birds and other wildlife.
